mentions.name: Chattymaps
mentions.description: This app helps groups find a place that works for everyone, working like a polling tool ("a doodle for places"). Users can create collections of places and ask for recommendations.
mentions.problem: Groups struggle to easily agree on a place that works for everyone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://chattymaps.com/

An easy way to find a place that works for everyone.   Think of it as a doodle for places.

You can also create collections of places, ask for recommendations etc.
